taiwan_aviation.headline: 颱風白海豚影響國籍航空沖繩航班多數取消
taiwan_aviation.summary: 受到颱風白海豚影響，台灣虎航、星宇航空、中華航空及長榮航空等國籍航空公司，已調整並取消2026年8月8日多數往返沖繩的航班。部分航空公司為此調整起飛時間，或於8月8日與9日安排加班機以疏運旅客，長榮航空也規劃於8月9日放大機型協助運送。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Typhoon White Dolphin Disrupts Taiwanese Airlines Flights to Okinawa
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Due to the impact of Typhoon White Dolphin, Taiwanese carriers including Taiwan Tigerair, STARLUX Airlines, China Airlines, and EVA Air have cancelled or rescheduled most of their flights to Okinawa on August 8, 2026. Taiwan Tigerair and China Airlines cancelled all of their Okinawa flights for the day, while STARLUX rescheduled some flights and added extra flights on August 8 and 9 to assist passengers. EVA Air, which cancelled all of its August 8 Okinawa flights, plans to upgrade its aircraft to Boeing 777-300ER on August 9 to facilitate travel.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 漢光演習第3天新竹基地演練跑道搶修與幻象緊急起飛
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國軍漢光42號實兵演習第3天，空軍第2戰術戰鬥機聯隊在新竹基地執行幻象2000戰機潛力裝掛、跑道搶修及緊急起飛演練，展現作戰韌性與持續力。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Han Kuang Exercise Day 3: Hsinchu Base Drills Runway Repair and Mirage Emergency Takeoff
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: On the third day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise, the Air Force's 2nd Tactical Fighter Wing conducted Mirage 2000 missile loading, runway crater repair, and emergency scramble drills at Hsinchu Air Base under a scenario simulating a missile attack on Taiwan.

taiwan_aviation.headline: A320 B-LPN 觀測抵達桃園機場
taiwan_aviation.summary: 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，註冊號 B-LPN 的 Airbus A320 於 2026 年 8 月 7 日確認抵達臺灣桃園國際機場，呼號 CRK261。

taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Public ADS-B observation data shows an Airbus A320 registered as B-LPN, using callsign CRK261, confirmed arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport on 7 August 2026.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 漢光演習第3天 第一作戰區動員無人機與戰車演練
taiwan_aviation.summary: 「漢光42號」演習於2026年8月7日進入第3天，第一作戰區於澎湖進行應援作戰演練。演習模擬敵特工襲擾海軍港口彈藥庫，軍方升空監偵型無人機提供即時影像，並結合M60A3戰車與海軍陸戰隊兵力實施圍捕封控，完成重要設施防衛任務。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan Drill Integrates Drones and M60A3 Tanks for Base Defense
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: On August 7, 2026, during the third day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise, the First Operational Zone conducted a support operation drill in Penghu County. The exercise simulated an enemy commando attack on a naval port ammunition depot, utilizing reconnaissance drones to stream real-time video imagery for command situational awareness. Integrated M60A3 tanks and Marine Corps personnel subsequently established crossfire positioning to encircle simulated hostile forces and protect key military infrastructure.

The exercise simulated enemy commando forces raiding a port ammunition depot, initiating a response integrating reconnaissance drones and M60A3 tanks.
Reconnaissance UAVs launched to transmit real-time video feeds for tactical planning, while M60A3 tanks adjusted firepower configuration to control surrounding areas.
Marine Corps personnel advanced toward the target area to suppress and contain simulated commandos, fulfilling key infrastructure defense tasks.
